meta.name: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
meta.description: The true story of the "Flying Sikh" world champion runner and Olympian Milkha Singh who overcame the massacre of his family, civil war during the India-Pakistan partition, and homelessness to become one of India's most iconic athletes.
meta.slogan: You know him as 'The Flying Sikh'. Now you will see his Real Story.
